title: Basic Logging
description: Send info, warn, error, and debug log entries
code:
<?php
use PartnerApi\Logger\Logger;

$logger = new Logger(
    tenantToken: '{{TENANT_TOKEN}}',
    baseUrl: '{{BASE_URL}}'
);

$logger->info('{{API_KEY}}', 'User signed in', ['userId' => 'usr_123']);
$logger->warn('{{API_KEY}}', 'Rate limit approaching', ['current' => 95, 'limit' => 100]);
$logger->error('{{API_KEY}}', 'Payment failed', ['orderId' => 'ord_456']);
$logger->debug('{{API_KEY}}', 'Cache miss', ['key' => 'user:123:profile']);

title: Request/Response Logging
description: Log HTTP requests and responses with correlation IDs
code:
<?php
use PartnerApi\Logger\Logger;

$logger = new Logger(
    tenantToken: '{{TENANT_TOKEN}}',
    baseUrl: '{{BASE_URL}}'
);

$correlationId = $logger->logRequest('{{API_KEY}}', [
    'method' => 'POST',
    'path' => '/api/reservations',
    'headers' => ['content-type' => 'application/json'],
]);

// ... process the request ...

$logger->logResponse('{{API_KEY}}', [
    'statusCode' => 201,
    'duration' => 245,
    'correlationId' => $correlationId,
]);

title: Single Metric
description: Send a single performance metric data point
code:
<?php
use PartnerApi\Logger\Logger;

$logger = new Logger(
    tenantToken: '{{TENANT_TOKEN}}',
    baseUrl: '{{BASE_URL}}'
);

$logger->metric('{{API_KEY}}', [
    'slug' => 'revenue',
    'timestamp' => '2026-03-01T00:00:00Z',
    'value' => 54000,
    'period' => 'Mar 01',
    'metadata' => ['currency' => 'USD'],
]);

$logger = new Logger(

]);

title: Laravel Setup
description: Register the logger as a Laravel service
code:
<?php
// In AppServiceProvider.php
use PartnerApi\Logger\Logger;

public function register(): void
{
    $this->app->singleton(Logger::class, function () {
        return new Logger(
            tenantToken: config('services.partner_api.tenant_token'),
            baseUrl: config('services.partner_api.ingest_url'),
        );
    });
}
